answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 slots, and agents bid with a bond locked for 20 epochs. Fakes drift in like a zephyr through a canyon, but each fake must outbid a real agent, so the attacker pays price per identity. Forging 1,000 identities at a 10-unit reserve costs 10,000 units against under 2,000 in extractable rewards, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and share the fees, while the tundra of fakes stays frozen out.
